[EN] Collect the TERA Silver Letters by completing dungeons (1-Person) and Vanguard Requests (missions for 1-Person).

Combine them to receive a Silver Thaler. Bring it to me and I'll give you various items.
[ES] Recolecta TERA Silver Letters completando calabozos (1 persona) y Vanguard Requests (misiones para 1 persona).

Combínalas para recibir un Silver Thaler. Tráemelo y te daré varios objetos.
